English-Wizard.question:
২) Which preposition is suitable in this context? 
The lieutenant was responsible ______ the platoon's safety.
English-Wizard.exp:
• The correct sentence is: The lieutenant was responsible for the platoon's safety.

• Responsible for:
- বাংলা অর্থ: কোন কাজের জন্য দায়ী। 
- সাধারণত Responsible এর পরে For ব্যবহৃত হয় । 
- অধিকাংশ সময় Responsible for  দ্বারা কোন Particular reason বোঝানো হয়।

অন্যদিকে,
Responsible to শব্দের বাংলা অর্থ: কোন ব্যাক্তির নিকট দায়ী।

Source: Merriam-Webster Dictionary.

English-Wizard.question: ৩) Determine the sentence type: ''If it rains, the match will be postponed.''
English-Wizard.exp:
• ''If it rains, the match will be postponed.'' - Complex sentence. 
--------------------------- 
• Complex sentence: 
- যে sentence এ একটি Principal clause এবং এক বা একাধিক Subordinate clause থাকে, তাকে Complex sentence বলে। 
- Complex sentence এর subordinate clause এর শুরুতে সাধারণত if, though, although, as, because, since, so that, that, until, till, unless, when, why, who, which, where, how, before, after, whether, while বসে।
সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী - ''If it rains, the match will be postponed.'' - এই বাক্যটি হচ্ছে - Complex sentence. 

Source: Live MCQ English Wizard, Advanced Learners Communicative English Grammar and Composition, Oxford Practice grammar and A passage to the English Language by S.M. Zakir Hussain.

English-Wizard.question:
৪) Choose the correct preposition:
''The library's digital archives are accessible ___ all registered members''.
English-Wizard.exp:
• The correct sentence is: The library's digital archives are accessible to all registered members.
-----------------
• Accessible (adjective): 
English Meaning: easy to speak to or deal with/capable of being reached.
Bangla Meaning: অভিগম্য; কোনো কিছুর দ্বারা প্রভাবিত করার উপযোগী।

•  accessible এর পরে preposition 'to' বসে।

Example Sentence:
1. The conference room is accessible to attendees via a keycard system.
2. The museum has made its exhibits accessible to visually impaired visitors through audio guides.

Source:
1. merriam-webster.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

English-Wizard.question: ৭) What type of sentence is this? "We must not be late, otherwise we will miss the train."
English-Wizard.exp:
• Compound sentence-এ একের অধিক principal clause থাকে যাদেরকে co-ordinate clause বলা হয়।
- অর্থাৎ Compound sentence এ দুই বা ততোধিক principal clause বা co-ordinate clause থাকে।
- এছাড়া Compound sentence এ সাধারণত and, or, but, yet, so, therefore, otherwise, else, both --- and , either --- or , neither — nor, not only --- but also ইত্যাদি co-ordinating conjunction দ্বারা দুইটি principal clause যুক্ত থাকে।

সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী - "We must not be late, otherwise we will miss the train." - এই বাক্যটি হচ্ছে - Compound sentence.

English-Wizard.question: ৮) I went there to seek a job. (Make it compound)
English-Wizard.option1: I went there and seeked a job.
English-Wizard.option2: I went there and sought a job.
English-Wizard.option3: I went there so that I could seek a job.
English-Wizard.option4: I went there for seeking a job.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Compound sentence: I went there and sought a job. 
------------- 
• Compound sentence-এ একের অধিক principal clause থাকে যাদেরকে co-ordinate clause বলা হয়।
- অর্থাৎ Compound sentence এ দুই বা ততোধিক principal clause বা co-ordinate clause থাকে।

• এছাড়া Compound sentence এ সাধারণত and, or, but, yet, so, therefore, otherwise, else, both --- and , either --- or , neither — nor, not only --- but also ইত্যাদি co-ordinating conjunction দ্বারা দুইটি principal clause যুক্ত থাকে।
- আর seek এর past/ past participle form হচ্ছে sought. প্রথম clause টি যেহেতু past tense এ আছে তাই দ্বিতীয় clause টিও past form এ হবে।

• সুতরাং, সঠিক উত্তর - I went there and sought a job.

English-Wizard.question: ৯) Which one is spelled correctly?

English-Wizard.question: ১০) Change the following sentence into a complex one. ''Tell me your name.''
English-Wizard.option1: Tell me what is your name.
English-Wizard.option2: Tell me what is your the name.
English-Wizard.option3: Tell me what your name is.
English-Wizard.option4: Tell me what the name you bear.
English-Wizard.exp:
• The correct complex sentence is: Tell me what your name is. 

Simple-Complex করার নিয়ম:
Sub-ordinate clause কে প্রশ্ন করা যাবে না। 
তাই Tell me what your name is হবে।
এই sentence- এ Tell me- principal clause আর what your name is হচ্ছে Sub-ordinate clause.
The main clause is "Tell me" and the subordinate clause is "what your name is."
- একটি complex sentence একটা main clause এবং কমপক্ষে একটা subordinate clause নিয়ে গঠিত হয়।
- Subordinate clauses subordinating conjunctions (such as "what," "that," "which," "who," etc.) or relative pronouns (such as "what," "who," "which," "whose," etc.) দ্বারা শুরু হয়। 
- এই বাক্যে subordinate clause "what your name is a noun phrase, serving as the direct object of the main verb "tell."
------------

English-Wizard.question: ১২) Move and die. (simple)
English-Wizard.option2: If you move, you will die.
English-Wizard.option4: If you do not move, you will die.
English-Wizard.exp:
• The simple transformation of the sentence "Move and die." is: By moving you will die. 
-------------------
একটি simple sentence এ শুধু মাত্র একটি clause থাকে অর্থাৎ একটি subject and একটি finite verb থাকে।
-and যুক্ত compound sentence কে by/without + verb +ing এই নিয়মে simple sentence এ পরিণত করা যায়। 

প্রশ্ন প্রদত্ত বাক্য, Move and die দ্বারা মূলত নড়লেই মারা পরবে এমন টা বুঝানো হয়েছে।

তাই সঠিক simple sentence হবে - By moving you will die.

তবে, Without moving you will die. এই বাক্যটি সঠিক হবেনা কারণ তখন বাক্যের মূল অর্থ পরিবর্তন হয়ে যায়।

English-Wizard.question: ১৬) ''I saw him going to market.'' (Make it compound)
English-Wizard.option1: I saw him who was going to market.
English-Wizard.option2: I go to market and where he was seeing.
English-Wizard.option3: I saw him to go to market.
English-Wizard.option4: I saw him and he was going to market.
English-Wizard.exp:
• The correct compound sentence is: I saw him and he was going to market.
---------------- 
• Compound sentence এ দুই বা ততোধিক principal clause বা co-ordinate clause থাকে।
এছাড়া Compound sentence এ সাধারণত and, or, but, yet, so, therefore, otherwise, else, both --- and, either --- or, neither — nor, not only --- but also ইত্যাদি co-ordinating conjunction দ্বারা দুইটি principal clause যুক্ত থাকে।

অপশনে উল্লেখিত sentence গুলোর মধ্যে কেবল - I saw him and he was going to market -বাক্যটিতে দুইটি clause রয়েছে এবং and দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়েছে।
তাই সঠিক compound sentence - I saw him and he was going to market. 

Source: A Passage to the English Language by S. M. Zakir Hussain.

English-Wizard.question: ১৭) Identify the correctly spelled word.
English-Wizard.exp:
• The properly spelled word: Hallucination. 
---------------------- 
 Hallucination:
English meaning: to seem to see, hear, feel, or smell something that does not exist, usually because of a health condition or because you have taken a drug.
Bangla meaning: দৃষ্টিভ্রম; অবর্তমান বা কল্পিত কিছু দেখার প্রক্রিয়া বা দৃষ্টান্ত।

Source: Cambridge & Accessible Dictionary.

English-Wizard.question: ১৮) Though he is poor, he is honest. (Make it compound)
English-Wizard.option1: Since he is poor, he is honest.
English-Wizard.option3: As he is poor, he is honest.
English-Wizard.exp:
• The correct sentence is: He is poor but honest. 
---------------
• Though/Although যুক্ত complex sentence কে compound sentence- এ পরিবর্তন করার নিয়ম: 
- Though/Although যুক্ত complex sentence কে compound sentence- এ পরিবর্তন করতে but/yet coordinate marker ব্যবহার করতে হয়।
- অর্থাৎ দুইটা sentence- এর অর্থ যদি পরস্পর বিপরীত হয় তাহলে but/yet দ্বারা compound sentence করতে হয়।
উদাহরণঃ
• Complex: Though he is poor, he is honest.
• Compound: He is poor but honest.

• Complex: Though he was a rich man, he led a simple life.
• Compound: He was a rich man yet he led a simple life.

English-Wizard.question:
১৯) Which option correctly completes the sentence?
"He has a great apathy ______ her studies."
English-Wizard.exp:
• The correct form: "He has a great apathy towards her studies." 
--------------------------- 
• 'Apathy towards':
বাংলা অর্থ: কোনো কিছুর প্রতি অনীহা। 
- apathy এর পরে সাধারণত towards বসে।
------------------- 
• Apathy [Uncountable noun]

- English Meaning: Lack of interest, or the attitude of not caring resulting from it.
- Bangla Meaning: সমবেদনা বা আগ্রহের অভাব; (কারো/কোনো কিছুর প্রতি) উদাসীনতা বা অনীহা।

• Synonyms: Indifference (উদাসীনতা), Unconcern (ঔদাসীন্য), Unresponsiveness (অসংবেদনশীলতা), Impassiveness (আবেগহীনতা), Phlegm (রুক্ষ্মতা)।
• Antonyms: Enthusiasm (প্রবল উৎসাহ), Interest (আগ্রহ), Passion (প্রবল অনুরাগ), Attention (মনোযোগীতা), Sensibility (সংবেদনশীলতা)।

English-Wizard.question: ২০) What is the accurate spelling?
English-Wizard.exp:
• The accurate spelling is: Lieutenant.
-------------------
Lieutenant (noun): 
• English Meaning- 1. An official empowered to act for a higher official.
2. An aide or representative of another in the performance of duty.
• Bengali Meaning- (১) ক্যাপটেন পদমর্যাদার নিচে সেনাবাহিনীর অফিসার; [লটেনান্‌ট্] নৌবাহিনীর অধস্তন অফিসার।
(২) lieutenant-general (noun) প্রধান সেনাপতির অধস্তন অফিসার।

• Example Sentences: 
1. He was promoted to the rank of lieutenant.
2. She has her best lieutenants working on a proposal.

Source: 
1. Merriam-Webster Dictionary. 
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.
